detectiveMessage: Miss Chloe, would you like to tell me your wareabouts of last night - be as secific as possible
aiMessage: I was at the delivery van until about ten forty. Then I went to Stephen's flat to check on him. It was a short chat, only about twenty minutes. I left around half past and drove home, arriving back by eleven twenty. I didn't know what happened until the police called.

detectiveMessage: We found Stephen's dead body, and the time of murder is ten thirty - eleven ten, right when you gon to visit him. Tell me why would you murder him?
aiMessage: I only went over to see Stephen because I heard he was in distress. We had a brief talk about the money he owed me, nothing more. I left before he was hurt, and I never had any intention of harming him. I don't understand why you'd think otherwise. Why are you treating me like the murderer?

detectiveMessage: ok can you tell me what exactly you talked about and this money you owed him - what is this about?
aiMessage: I was just dropping by to check on him. We talked a little about the small sum he owed me, nothing major. It was just a friendly chat, nothing else. I left before the end of the hour.

detectiveMessage: How much time does it take for you to reach home from his place?
aiMessage: It usually takes me about twenty minutes to get home from there. I left the flat around eleven, and I had no idea anything had happened until the police called.

detectiveMessage: And at what time exactly did you reach his house? and also we found the murder weapon with your fingerprints on it?
aiMessage: I arrived at the flat around 10:41 p.m. and left after our brief chat, well before 11 p.m. I had no idea what happened after that. I didn't touch or handle any wine bottle – so if there are fingerprints, someone else must have been there.
